def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    # Join every diagonally aligned pair of 1 markers; at a 6 marker on
    # that diagonal, draw the crossing diagonal of 6s to the grid edges.
    seen_lines = set()
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if dr == 0 or abs(dr) != abs(dc):
                continue
            sr, sc = (1 if dr > 0 else -1), (1 if dc > 0 else -1)
            key = (c1-r1 if sr == sc else c1+r1, sr, sc)
            if key in seen_lines:
                continue
            seen_lines.add(key)
            # Fill the segment between the two 1s, retaining 6 markers.
            r, c = r1, c1
            while True:
                if out[r][c] != 6:
                    out[r][c] = 1
                if (r, c) == (r2, c2):
                    break
                r += sr; c += sc
            # Any 6 on the joined line emits a full opposite-slope diagonal.
            for r in range(min(r1, r2), max(r1, r2) + 1):
                c = c1 + (r-r1) * sc if sr == 1 else c1 + (r-r1) * sc
                if 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == 6:
                    pr, pc = sr, -sc
                    rr, cc = r, c
                    while 0 <= rr-pr < h and 0 <= cc-pc < w:
                        rr -= pr; cc -= pc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                        if out[rr][cc] not in (1, 6):
                            out[rr][cc] = 6
                        rr += pr; cc += pc
    return out
PY
